articles.title: Rand Paul Formally Accuses Fauci of Perjury — Demands DOJ Open Criminal Investigation Into Gain-of-Function Lies

articles.title: Ensign Group Hid Patient Neglect, Falsified Staffing Data, and Billed Fraudulently — Stock Collapses When Truth Surfaces

articles.title: Accidental Live Vaccines Given to 220 Immunocompromised Patients — Zero Disease Outbreaks: What Does That Tell Us About Vaccine Risk Models?

The medical establishment continues to categorically ban live vaccines in this population based on theoretical risk models, yet this accidental trial data directly challenges that blanket prohibition. This finding fundamentally challenges the static tumor model that underpins most current oncology treatment protocols and clinical trial design. The metabolic and evolutionary plasticity of cancer cells demands a paradigm shift that the oncology-industrial complex has been slow to finance.
